title: Whispers in the gallery
text: You hear something ruinous about a Great House — true enough to wound, loose enough to deny. Words are weapons that leave no fingerprints. Usually.

then.tpl: By week's end every salon repeats your whisper as their own discovery. A rival house bleeds standing; you gain it. +20 prestige.

else.tpl: The whisper is traced to your table. Liars are remembered longer than scandals. −18 prestige.

choices.label: Sell the secret back to them

then.tpl: They pay handsomely for your discretion. +${{g}}. Everyone understands the arrangement.

else.tpl: They call your bluff and bury the story — and your reputation with it. −10 prestige.

effects.tpl: Some weapons are too dirty to hold. You wash your hands of it.
